payload.posture: Read Exodus 13:17–22 as one movement in Joseph's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the departure route, Joseph’s oath, his bones, divine guidance, cloud, and fire move together at the opening of the wilderness journey. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Joseph's story.
payload.title: Moses carries Joseph’s bones out of Egypt
